description: Scene Tween is an aesthetic that emerged approximately in the early 2010s, combining elements of Kidcore and the Scene subculture. This fusion arose as mainstream culture began marketing the original Scene aesthetic towards children, much like Teenpunk with its emo -inspired imagery, but targeting an even younger audience. Scene Tween retains many of the visual elements of Scene , such as animal patterns and bright colours, but with a distinctly childish and feminine twist.
